title: Prior-aware Dynamic Temporal Modeling Framework for Sequential 3D Hand Pose Estimation
caption: Figure 2. Overall Architecture. Our method comprises three primary components: the Dynamic Spatio-temporal Block, the Global Temporal Block, and the Hand Prior Memory. The Dynamic Spatio-temporal Block employs a dual-branch structure to model joint-level spatial and temporal relationships, while the Global Temporal Block extracts hand-level temporal information. We leverage hand-level temporal information to update the hand prior memory, injecting this prior knowledge into the Dynamic Spatio-temporal Block to provide robust disambiguation cues for spatio-temporal interactions. Here, N represents the number of stacked blocks.
